name: fantasy-minimal-magazine
tagline_zh: 编辑页的留白和字号，不是方图加字
desc_en: Create FANTASY-branded 3:4 minimal editorial magazine posters from user-provided images by reading the image, reducing visual information, translating it into abstract editorial material, composing with large whitespace, and generating content-driven typography. Use when the user asks for "fantasy-极简杂志", "极简杂志海报", "编辑出版海报", "图片转译海报", "FANTASY magazine poster", or wants a quiet archival/minimal pub
why_zh: 按杂志封面的格子重排主题。品牌味在版式里，不在滤镜里。
limit_zh: 页是 3:4 封面。要长图文、要视频封面，格不对。
